title: Renew a security master licence
summary: You can renew and pay for your security master licence online if you have received a renewal form and the licence has not expired by more than 90 days.
intro:
If you've received a security licence renewal form, you can renew and pay online. There are 2 types of renewals:

### If your licence has expired

If it is more than 90 days after the expiry date on your licence you need to submit a new application. You cannot trade until your new licence is issued.
who_can_apply: Must have received a renewal form and the expiry date must not be over 90 days.
Must satisfy stringent integrity requirements, including those related to any close associates.
Must declare details of any close associates of the business.
Must hold, or will hold, any relevant financial interest in the business.
Must be, or will be, entitled to exercise any relevant power in the business.
Must hold, or will hold, any relevant position (e.g., director, manager).
what_you_need: Your renewal number (as shown on your renewal notice), or your personal details.

how_to_steps.text: Follow the prompts to renew your security master licence.

internal_links.text: Get a firearms or security industry licence issued

faqs.q: What should I do if my security licence has expired?
faqs.a: If your licence has expired by more than 90 days, you must submit a new application. You cannot trade until your new licence is issued.

faqs.q: Who is eligible to apply for a master licence?
faqs.a: To qualify, you must satisfy stringent integrity requirements, declare details of any close associates, and hold or be entitled to relevant financial interests or positions in the business.

faqs.q: Can a master licence be given to a partnership?
faqs.a: No, a master licence cannot be issued to a partnership, and it is not transferable.
